author: Cleo Abram
description:
Do you know the real story of the brand new cat species they just discovered?

A guy in Bolivia first found it, he thought it was a pet kitten and brought it home, but after a year of having it he was like, “I don’t…think this is a house cat….” 

So he brought it to an animal sanctuary and they were like, “Yeah, this is a full grown, 10-year old wild cat," so the sanctuary called this biologist who noticed differences between it and other tiger cat species, so she ran some DNA and found this was a BRAND NEW species of cat!

But can you guess this other animal? To see what it is, subscribe!

#cat #species #animal #tilcayo #DNA #science
title: The Real Story of the New Cat Species
